notes: CHECKS, NOT CHANGES. Nothing in this build looks different — it adds two checks that must pass before any future release can be built. THE PRINTED LEDGER EXTRACT MUST FOOT TO THE LEDGER. Its Totals row is now verified against the ledger itself, and so is the number of lines it prints, because a total can foot a partial list perfectly and still be wrong. This report has been wrong in exactly that way before: it once read the first 2,000 entries and totalled those, presenting them as the whole. A SAFETY CHECK MUST REACH EVERY PLACE THAT POSTS. When a screen decides it cannot safely act — because a figure it relies on could not be read — that decision must now be respected by every part of the screen that writes to your ledger, not only the buttons you can see. Building this found one more place in the fixed-asset register where the depreciation journal was written without it. Nothing you have posted was ever at risk, because every route to it was already protected; the protection now sits on the writing itself, so a future change cannot get around it. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your books and settings are untouched and this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
